purpose: Teach: 親御/チェス/ブラームス/目覚める/下山/泥沼/すっと/彷彿

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、親御、絶対、さん、絶対、と、絶対、お話、絶対、してきたわ
lines.en: Sho, I talked to your friends' parents about this—I was completely serious.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Gentle but firm. Speaking as someone who follows through on promises. Eye contact soft but steady. No performance, just care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、チェス、絶対、習いたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really do want to learn chess. I'm serious about it.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. No pleading—just honest statement. Sits up slightly straighter. Small, genuine voice. Waiting to be believed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、ブラームス、絶対、CD、絶対、家で、絶対、流してるわ、翔くん
lines.en: I've been playing my favorite Brahms CD at home, Sho. The one I love.
lines.style: Soft, intimate tone. Speaking as if sharing something treasured. Gentle pace. A small smile in the voice—not performing, just contentment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、自然に、絶対、目覚める、絶対、こと、絶対、増えたよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: I've been waking up naturally in the mornings now, Mei-sis. It's really different.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Small but genuine. Voice steady but not loud. The satisfaction of noticing something good about himself. No bragging—just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、山登りの後の、絶対、下山、絶対、慎重に、絶対、するのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandfather is very careful on the way down the mountain after a climb, Sho. That matters.
lines.style: Reflective, gently thoughtful. Slower pace. Speaking from observation, not instruction. Warm but contemplative. Like she's sharing something she's learned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 前回のテスト、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、泥沼、絶対、にハマっちゃったよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: I really got stuck on the last test—totally lost in it, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware. Light tone without shame. Small laugh underneath. Honest about struggle but not drowning in it. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お話する時、絶対、すっと、絶対、姿勢、絶対、伸ばしているのね、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: When you talk, Sho, you sit up so straight. I really admire that about you.
lines.style: Genuine admiration. Warm, noticing tone. Speaks slowly, like she's really seeing him. No flattery—just honest observation. Tender without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんを、絶対、彷彿、絶対、と、絶対、させるよ
lines.en: You remind me of your grandmother, Mei-sis. In the best way.
lines.style: Soft, tender. Small voice but sincere. Like he's giving her a real gift with the comparison. No hesitation—just honesty. Close, intimate.
